security_audit.summary: The main confirmed risks are intentional RunComfy CLI execution and outbound submission to RunComfy hosted model APIs. Most static hits are Markdown backticks, documentation links, ellipsis URL paths, or harmless wording, and I found no prompt injection attempt. Users should treat prompts, reference media, and token-backed requests as third-party data processing.

remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation before installing tools, logging in, or running RunComfy commands on behalf of a user.
Warn users that prompts, reference images, and job metadata are sent to RunComfy infrastructure.
Do not print tokens, embed tokens in prompts, or store shared credentials in generated project files.
Keep the documented host whitelist, explicit output directory, and file size cap for downloaded results.

content.user_title: Generate Flux 2 Klein Images on RunComfy
content.value_statement: Fast image models need precise prompts and variant choices. This skill guides Flux 2 Klein generation through RunComfy with practical defaults.
actual_capabilities: Routes Flux 2 Klein requests to the RunComfy CLI for text-to-image generation.
Explains when to use the 4B variant for fast iteration or the 9B variant for polish.
Provides prompt patterns for subject-first composition, lighting, camera, and quality details.
Documents width, height, step count, and reference image limits for the model.
Describes output download behavior, exit codes, and expected RunComfy authentication.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a working RunComfy account or token.
Sends prompts and referenced media to RunComfy hosted model infrastructure.
Does not provide native 4K output or aspect ratios wider than 16:9.
Is not a self-hosted Flux runner and does not include a local model.

use_cases.title: Create rapid visual concepts
use_cases.description: Use the 4B variant to explore art direction quickly before choosing a final image direction.

use_cases.title: Generate product asset drafts
use_cases.description: Use structured prompts for product photos, lighting, framing, and e-commerce style previews.

use_cases.title: Prepare branded image variations
use_cases.description: Use aligned reference images to keep style, composition, and visual identity consistent across assets.

prompt_templates.title: Start a quick concept
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for fast image exploration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux 2 Klein 4B to create a quick concept image of [subject] in [scene]. Keep the prompt concise and show the chosen settings.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a product prompt
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a cleaner product image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite my product image prompt for Flux 2 Klein. Include subject, scene, lighting, camera, composition, and quality details.

prompt_templates.title: Plan reference guided generation
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Flux 2 Klein prompt that keeps the style of my reference images while changing [target change]. Note any reference image risks.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the right model path
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request comparing speed, detail, and output limits.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this image request for Flux 2 Klein 4B, Flux 2 Klein 9B, or another model. Explain the route and generation settings.

output_examples.input: Create a fast concept for a ceramic mug on a wooden table with soft morning light.
output: Selected Flux 2 Klein 4B for rapid iteration.
Produced a subject-first prompt with product, surface, lighting, lens, and quality details.
Recommended a square preview size and a low step count for concept review.

output_examples.input: Make a polished brand image from two reference photos with the same composition and updated label color.
output: Selected Flux 2 Klein 9B for stronger detail and final polish.
Preserved composition and lighting while changing the label color in the prompt.
Flagged that reference images are sent to RunComfy for processing.

output_examples.input: Generate a wide hero image for a website at very high resolution.
output: Explained the 16:9 aspect ratio and approximate 2K output ceiling.
Suggested a wide supported size for Flux 2 Klein.
Recommended another model when native 4K output is required.

best_practices: Start prompts with the main subject, then add scene, style, lighting, camera, and quality details.
Use 4B for fast exploration and 9B when the selected direction needs more polish.
Keep reference images visually aligned so style guidance remains consistent.
anti_patterns: Do not send sensitive prompts, private images, or confidential brand references to hosted model APIs.
Do not request unsupported 4K output or extreme aspect ratios from Flux 2 Klein.
Do not mix conflicting styles or long vague prompt text when precise output is needed.

faq.question: Does this skill run Flux 2 Klein locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses the RunComfy CLI to call hosted RunComfy model endpoints.

faq.question: Which variant should I use for fast drafts?
faq.answer: Use Flux 2 Klein 4B for rapid concepting and live iteration.

faq.question: Which variant should I use for final images?
faq.answer: Use Flux 2 Klein 9B when you need stronger detail and polished output.

faq.question: Can it use reference images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents reference image use, but those references are processed by RunComfy.

faq.question: Does it support precise text inside images?
faq.answer: It can help with simple text, but another model is better for heavy or multilingual text.

faq.question: What authentication is required?
faq.answer: You need a RunComfy login or a RUNCOMFY_TOKEN environment variable for CLI access.
